DefectClassicalAnisotropic.statement: if N is anisotropic and N(x)N(y) != 0, then N(xy - yx) = 0 iff dim Q <= 2 iff Delta(x, y) = I, so the similarity class of Delta(x, y) depends only on the Gram matrix of (1, x, y)
DefectClassicalAnisotropic.scope: octonion algebras with anisotropic norm over a field of characteristic not 2, in particular the definite octonions over Q of convention cayley-dickson/v1 with parameters (-1, -1, -1)
depends_on: for N(x)N(y) != 0 the similarity class of Delta(x, y) depends only on the Gram matrix of (1, x, y) and on dim Q; dim Q matters only when N(xy - yx) = 0, where the Gram matrix does not determine it
det Gram_B(1, x, y, xy) = N(xy - yx)^2 and det(Y I - L_x L_y L_conj(xy)) = (Y - nu)^4 (Y^2 - (2 nu - N(xy - yx)) Y + nu^2)^2 with nu = N(x)N(y), for all x, y
rank(Delta(x, y) - I) is 0, 2, 4 when dim Q is at most 2, 3, 4 respectively
evidence: proof written in paper/associator-defects/main.tex (Corollary 3.33); awaiting independent review; replayed over Z^8 in tests/test_h3_integral.py; single defects on integral shells are classical before reduction

H3IntegralPilot.statement: for reduced length-4 words in m generators of the integral shell {x in Z^8 : N(x) = p} and their conjugates, with exact arithmetic, value-only collisions (equal values, different operators L_a1 ... L_a4) are absent in three of five configurations; in the other two (p = 3, 12 or 14 letters, 195 and 477 pairs) they share the characteristic polynomial of their word defect in 50 and 22 percent of pairs, against 8 and 7 percent for pairs of different values with equal trace and 4 and 2 percent for random pairs
H3IntegralPilot.scope: definite octonions over Z, convention cayley-dickson/v1 with parameters (-1, -1, -1); characteristic polynomials compared modulo 2^61 - 1
evidence: (p, generators, seed) in {(3, 12, 1), (3, 12, 2), (3, 12, 3), (3, 14, 1), (5, 12, 1)}; all reduced words of length 4; nulls of 300 pairs each
